trigger: 声明一个语义选择条件 when its declared inputs are available.

inputs.name: target_object_requirements
inputs.description: Object with required keys `object_type`, `meaning`, and `required_properties` for one target object.

inputs.name: geometry_properties
inputs.description: Array of property objects, each with required keys `name`, `value`, `unit`, and `source_ref`; properties must be measurable.

inputs.name: selection_tolerance
inputs.description: Object with required keys `criteria`, `value`, `unit`, and `comparison` for approximate matching.

inputs.name: topology_refresh_prerequisite
inputs.description: Optional MS-07 output with required keys `action_id`, `affected_references`, `refresh_before_next_selection`, and `refresh_scope`; it is consumed, not synthesized.

preconditions: 所需属性可测且目标类型确定
Use only this single-action procedure; source or upstream instance references must be supplied.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: One 语义选择谓词 in the common envelope; data fields: semantic_predicate, ambiguity_policy.

postconditions: 条件与目标含义匹配并定义无解及多解处理
The typed result and provenance agree with the declared single-action scope; unsupported required fields withhold a resolved result.

implementation.target_environment: Source interpretation or strategy reasoning; no SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: No standalone deterministic interpreter is claimed. Apply only MS-06 in the hash-bound guidance reference using atomic-reasoning-protocol.md.

ambiguity_checks: Reject recorded FaceN, BodyN, index, or Boolean-return order as a reusable semantic criterion.
Reject an unmeasurable requirement, missing tolerance for an approximate comparison, or an object type that is not determined.
Reject an absent or malformed MS-07 prerequisite when topology refresh is required; do not synthesize one inside MS-06.
Do not execute selection, return a selected object, or claim uniqueness when zero or multiple candidates remain.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: No geometry handles are acquired; declarations do not mutate or refresh application topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared action inputs cannot support a unique required result.
failure_modes.detection: Apply the action rejection rules and inspect raw source evidence.
failure_modes.safe_state: Return actionable unresolved fields; retain original evidence and values.

recovery.action: Supply only the missing source or prerequisite, then repeat this action; do not invent geometry or start application execution.

validation.method: Inspect named inputs, result fields, procedure and rejection rules for MS-06
validate_atomic_reasoning.py with an actual source manifest; separately review interpretation against raw material.
validation.expected: 条件与目标含义匹配并定义无解及多解处理

host_checked.notes: Host structure/invariants and bounded independent source evaluation; no automatic promotion.

evidence_level.notes: Candidate. Structural tests cannot establish source interpretation accuracy or any SpaceClaim runtime capability.
